LanguageData.MDWC_StatSeverityPerKitDesc: The total severity of injuries one kit of medicine treats, as one vanilla treatment does. A disease, infection or fresh missing part takes a whole kit.
LanguageData.MDWC_GaugeKitDesc: Each kit treats up to {0} severity of injuries, or one disease, infection or fresh missing part.
LanguageData.MDWC_SettingsUnavailable: These settings are unavailable. Another mod has changed the medic warcasket's definitions, so the set keeps its built-in values.
LanguageData.MDWC_MedicineDesc: The medicine the armor's suite is loaded with. Herbal medicine is too crude for the carriers. Kits already loaded count as the new medicine. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_TintDesc: The color of the dressing's glow, stream and overlay, and of the suite's gauge. A dressing already running keeps its color until it ends. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_KitsDesc: The number of medicine kits the armor's suite holds when full. A suite already holding more than this loses the excess. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_CastTimeDesc: How long the suite primes before the stream reaches the patient. The patient is held still from the start. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_TendIntervalDesc: How long the stream spends on each wound or illness. A patient with more to treat keeps the stream, and the hold, going longer. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_CooldownDesc: The time the pilot must wait after a dressing before starting another. Queued dressings wait it out. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_RangeDesc: How close the pilot walks to the patient before starting the stream, which also needs a clear line of sight. Default: {0}.
LanguageData.MDWC_DressingSummary: The suite holds up to {0} kits of {1}, each treating {2} severity of injuries or one illness. A dressing warms up for {3} s, then tends a wound every {4} s, with {5} s of cooldown after.
LanguageData.MDWC_DressingSummaryNoCooldown: The suite holds up to {0} kits of {1}, each treating {2} severity of injuries or one illness. A dressing warms up for {3} s, then tends a wound every {4} s, and the next can start at once.
